review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with strong engineering mindset, hands-on automation skills and the ambition to grow. The role is suitable for someone with minimum 3 years of experience who already takes ownership, works independently on technical improvements and has the potential to become a senior engineer within the next year. Work closely with Java backend, frontend, PO, CJE, architects and Chapter Lead to define technical requirements and production-readiness criteria. Analyze requirements and define their applicability inside the technical environment. Experience What you’ll bring to the team Minimum 3 years of experience in a DevOps, Operations Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering or similar role. Hands-on experience with at least one automation tool such as Ansible, Terraform.
